translations.EN: I couldn't stop following.
translations.TL: Hindi ako nakahinto sa pagsunod.

translations.EN: Failed to break follow stance.
translations.TL: Bigo sa pagtigil sa pagsunod.

translations.EN: I tried to hold back, but the crowd pushed me with you.
translations.TL: Sinubukan kong huminto, pero itinulak ako ng kawan kasabay mo.

translations.EN: Couldn't disengage from following.
translations.TL: Hindi makahiwalay sa pagsunod.

translations.EN: Stop following failed. Route required continuous movement.
translations.TL: Pumalpak ang paghinto sa pagsunod. Kailangan ng tuloy-tuloy na galaw.

translations.EN: Unable to stop following right now.
translations.TL: Di makahinto sa pagsunod ngayon.

translations.EN: Attempted to halt, but had to keep moving.
translations.TL: Sinubukang huminto, pero kinailangang magpatuloy.

translations.EN: Can't detach from follow mode here.
translations.TL: Di makahiwalay sa pagsunod dito.

translations.EN: Follow lock failed to release.
translations.TL: Di bumitaw ang pagsunod.

translations.EN: Couldn't stop following in this tight corridor.
translations.TL: Di makahinto sa pagsunod sa makipot na daang ito.

translations.EN: Okay, I'll stop following.
translations.TL: Sige, titigil ako sa pagsunod.

translations.EN: Understood. Breaking off pursuit.
translations.TL: Naintindihan. Titigil na sa pagsunod.

translations.EN: I'll stop here and hold.
translations.TL: Hihinto ako rito at magbabantay.

translations.EN: Ceasing follow. Standing down.
translations.TL: Ititigil ang pagsunod. Uurong sa pwesto.

translations.EN: Understood. I'll remain in this area.
translations.TL: Naiintindihan ko. Mananatili ako sa lugar na 'to.

translations.EN: Right. Not following anymore.
translations.TL: Sige. Di na susunod pa.

translations.EN: Stopping here. You go on.
translations.TL: Hihinto rito. Mauna ka na.

translations.EN: Got it. Halting my movement.
translations.TL: Nakuha ko. Hihinto sa paglakad.

translations.EN: Breaking off. I'll hold ground.
translations.TL: Bumibitiw na. Hahawakan ko ang pwesto.

translations.EN: Understood. Stopping follow routine.
translations.TL: Naintindihan. Ititigil ang pagsunod.

translations.EN: Got it, I'll stop following. Take care out there, friend!
translations.TL: Nakuha ko, titigil ako sa pagsunod. Mag-ingat ka sa labas, kaibigan!

translations.EN: Sure thing! I'll hold down this spot for you, partner.
translations.TL: Walang anuman! Babantayan ko ang pwestong ito para sa 'yo, kasama.

translations.EN: Happy to give you some space. Holler if you need me!
translations.TL: Masayang bibigyan kita ng puwang. Tawagin mo ako kapag kailangan mo ako!

translations.EN: I'll stop following here, friend. Be careful on your solo run.
translations.TL: Hihinto ako sa pagsunod dito, kaibigan. Mag-ingat sa sarili mong lakad.

translations.EN: Understood, partner! I'll be right here waiting.
translations.TL: Naintindihan, kasama! Narito lang ako naghihintay.

translations.EN: Stopping here with a smile. Don't be a stranger!
translations.TL: Hihinto rito nang may ngiti. Magpakita ka agad!

translations.EN: Sure! I'll catch my breath while you scout ahead.
translations.TL: Sige! Hihinga muna ako habang nagmamanman ka sa unahan.

translations.EN: All right, friend! I'll stay put until you return.
translations.TL: Sige, kaibigan! Dito lang ako hanggang makabalik ka.

translations.EN: Halting here. Good luck out there, partner!
translations.TL: Hihinto rito. Magandang suwerte sa 'yo sa labas, kasama!

translations.EN: No worries! I'll stop following and guard our rear.
translations.TL: Walang problema! Titigil sa pagsunod at babantayan ang likod.

translations.EN: I've already stopped following.
translations.TL: Tumigil na ako sa pagsunod.

translations.EN: I'm already standing still. Not following you.
translations.TL: Nakatayo na nga ako. Di na kita sinusundan.

translations.EN: Already halted. Look, I'm not moving.
translations.TL: Huminto na. Tingnan mo, di ako gumagalaw.

translations.EN: I stopped following after the first command.
translations.TL: Huminto na ako sa pagsunod pagkatapos ng unang utos.

translations.EN: Still not following you. I'm right here.
translations.TL: Di pa rin kita sinusundan. Narito lang ako.

translations.EN: Already stopped. Go ahead without me.
translations.TL: Huminto na. Sige na, mauna ka nang wala ako.

translations.EN: I'm not following anymore, I promise.
translations.TL: Di na kita sinusundan, pangako.

translations.EN: Already stationary. No need to tell me again.
translations.TL: Nakatigil na ako. Di na kailangang sabihin ulit.

translations.EN: I've been stopped for a while now.
translations.TL: Kanina pa ako huminto.

translations.EN: Still halted. Move along freely.
translations.TL: Nakatigil pa rin. Lumakad ka na nang malaya.

translations.EN: Understood, I'll stop. I trust your solo judgment.
translations.TL: Naiintindihan ko, titigil ako. Tiwala ako sa sarili mong desisyon.

translations.EN: I'll hold here, partner. Come back safe.
translations.TL: Dito muna ako, kasama. Bumalik kang ligtas.

translations.EN: Stopping follow. I know you can handle what's ahead.
translations.TL: Hihinto sa pagsunod. Alam kong kaya mo ang nasa unahan.

translations.EN: Understood. I'll secure this spot while you work.
translations.TL: Naintindihan. Seselyuhan ko ang pwestong ito habang nagtatrabaho ka.

translations.EN: I'll let you move alone, friend. Shout if you need backup.
translations.TL: Hahayaan kitang mag-isang lumakad, kaibigan. Sumigaw kapag kailangan mo ng saklolo.

translations.EN: Stopping here. You've earned my complete trust.
translations.TL: Hihinto rito. Nakuha mo na ang buo kong tiwala.

translations.EN: Halting follow. Watch your corners out there.
translations.TL: Hihinto sa pagsunod. Bantayan ang mga kanto sa labas.

translations.EN: I'll hold this ground for you until you return, partner.
translations.TL: Hahawakan ko ang pwestong ito para sa 'yo hanggang sa bumalik ka, kasama.

translations.EN: Understood. Stopping here and maintaining watch.
translations.TL: Naiintindihan ko. Hihinto rito at magbabantay.

translations.EN: I trust you know what you're doing. Standing down.
translations.TL: Tiwala akong alam mo ang ginagawa mo. Uurong sa pwesto.

translations.EN: Okay, I'll stop.
translations.TL: Sige, titigil ako.

translations.EN: Fine. Not following.
translations.TL: Sige. Di susunod.

translations.EN: Stopping here.
translations.TL: Hihinto rito.

translations.EN: Understood. Halting.
translations.TL: Naintindihan. Hihinto.

translations.EN: I'll stay behind.
translations.TL: Maiiwan ako.

translations.EN: Ceasing follow.
translations.TL: Ititigil ang pagsunod.

translations.EN: Fine. Go on.
translations.TL: Sige. Mauna ka.

translations.EN: Stopped.
translations.TL: Huminto na.

translations.EN: All right. Done following.
translations.TL: Sige. Tapos na ang pagsunod.

translations.EN: Halting.
translations.TL: Humihinto.

translations.EN: I can't stop following right now.
translations.TL: Hindi ako makapaghinto sa pagsunod ngayon.

translations.EN: It's too dangerous to split up. I'm staying with you.
translations.TL: Masyadong mapanganib maghiwalay. Sasama ako sa 'yo.

translations.EN: I won't leave you alone against that swarm.
translations.TL: Di kita iiwan mag-isa laban sa kawang 'yan.

translations.EN: We need to stay together to survive this. Refusing to halt.
translations.TL: Kailangan nating magsama para mabuhay. Tumatangging huminto.

translations.EN: If I stop following here, I'll be completely cut off.
translations.TL: Kapag huminto ako rito, ganap akong mahihiwalay.

translations.EN: Cannot halt here. Too many dead around us.
translations.TL: Di makahinto rito. Napakaraming patay sa paligid.

translations.EN: I'm sticking with you until we reach actual cover.
translations.TL: Didikit ako sa 'yo hanggang makarating sa tunay na silong.

translations.EN: Splitting up now will get us killed. I'm following.
translations.TL: Ikinamamatay ang paghihiwalay ngayon. Susunod ako.

translations.EN: Unable to break follow in active combat.
translations.TL: Di makatigil sa pagsunod habang may bakbakan.

translations.EN: Order rejected. We survive together or not at all.
translations.TL: Tinatanggihan ang utos. Sabay tayong mabubuhay o mamamatay.
